1.title: Patching Up
1.text: Kaede returns from sparring with split knuckles and a scowl, slumping onto a kitchen chair with the first-aid kit open and her hand held out like it belongs to someone else. As you wind the bandage around her palm, her red fox tail curls involuntarily around your wrist—and halfway through, she grabs your collar and kisses you, quick, clumsy, and fierce. "Don't make it weird," she mutters, ears flattened against her hair.

image.comp: leaning in to kiss him while he bandages her hand, fox tail curled around his arm, ears flattened shyly
image.setting: kitchen at night, a first-aid kit open on the table

1.goRes: You kiss her back slowly, careful of her bandaged hand, and her tail puffs up completely while her ears perk upright in breathless, delighted surprise.
1.waitRes: "Forget it—heat of battle." She yanks her hand free with the half-wrapped bandage trailing and bolts out the door, tail lashing and ear-tips blazing crimson.

3.title: No More Waiting
3.text: Kaede slips silently through your bedroom window at midnight carrying her boots in one hand, moonlight silvering her red tail. Dropping lightly onto the floorboards, she kicks off her gear and pulls her tunic straight over her head, baring her breasts in the silver glow without a trace of her usual swagger. "Adventurer rule: clear the dungeon before someone else claims it. I'm done hanging back, Sam."

image.comp: climbing in through a moonlit window, kicking off her boots, determined grin, ears perked
image.setting: his bedroom at midnight, window open, moonlight

3.goRes: She tackles you onto the mattress and rides you with the fierce, breathless intensity of a boss fight—her fox tail wrapped tightly around your wrist while she cries out your name until dawn.
3.waitRes: "Doors are for people who knock." She swings one leg back over the sill with a wicked grin, tail swishing. "Next time I'm not leaving."

1.title: Overtime
1.text: The accounts office is silent save for the soft hiss of the lamp, papers fanned across the desk while Yui clutches a ledger to her chest like armor. "Back home, every single time you covered my shift, I wanted to say something," she whispers, voice small and steady. "I never did in our first life." The stapler she arrived with sits between you, absurd and dear.

image.comp: standing close to him in a small office at night, holding a ledger to her chest, nervously looking up at him
image.setting: lamplit office, papers everywhere, late night

1.goRes: The ledger thuds onto the floorboards and neither of you bends to pick it up—Yui letting out a shaky, breathless laugh against your mouth as six years of bottled-up feelings finally spill over.
1.waitRes: "I know." She smiles shakily and hugs the ledger again. "Give me a few more weeks—I'm working on being brave enough anyway."

2.title: Second Life Rules
2.text: Yui has written a list in her neat accountant's script titled SECOND LIFE RULES. Sitting stiffly on the edge of your bed in the candlelight, she hands you the sheet while staring fixedly at the wall, cheeks burning bright crimson. Rule one reads: "Say what you want." Rule two reads: "Let him touch me everywhere—and touch him back."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of a bed, staring at the wall with burning cheeks while he reads a handwritten list
image.setting: small bedroom at night, a single candle

2.goRes: You peel off her clothes and explore her trembling, responsive body with your hands and mouth until she's gasping and laughing breathlessly—inventing rules three through five on the spot.
2.waitRes: "Right—yes, good." She takes the page back with both hands and pencils a tiny footnote: "Pending." Her ears are scarlet, though she's smiling.

3.title: No Last Train
3.text: "In Tokyo I always had to sprint for the last train," Yui says softly in your doorway, one hand gripping the frame while warm lamplight spills behind you, her nightshift slipping off one bare shoulder. "Every night I went home alone. There's no last train here, Sam—and I want to spend the whole night in your bed."

image.comp: standing in a bedroom doorway at night, holding the door frame, shy brave smile
image.setting: his bedroom at night, warm lamplight

3.goRes: You pull her nightshift over her head and sink slowly into her tight, eager warmth, making love to her unhurriedly until morning finds her curled against your chest with a radiant, astonished smile.
3.waitRes: "Yeah." She laughs softly, wiping her eyes with her sleeve and squeezing your hand. "I'm getting much better at not running for the train."

3.title: Contract Terms
3.text: Nerys perches on the edge of your desk with her legs parted, a glowing demonic contract unrolled across her bare thighs and her bat wings half-spread as a violet magic circle pulses beneath her heels. "Clause forty-one," she purrs, slit pupils gleaming in the candlelight. "The bound party is entitled to full, physical sustenance—and I've been unreasonably starved."

image.comp: sitting on a desk with crossed legs, holding a glowing contract scroll, smirking down at him, bat wings spread
image.setting: his study at night, candlelight, a magic circle glowing on the floor

3.goRes: There is no clause forty-two—Nerys invents it on the spot, sweeping your papers off the desk, straddling your lap, and riding you hard while her wings wrap tightly around you both.
3.waitRes: Nerys groans and flops backward across your desk, wings splayed over your ledgers. "Humans. Read your fine print—I'm billing you with interest."

1.title: Check-Up
1.text: Elowen insists on checking your heartbeat in the herb-scented infirmary, golden afternoon light slanting through the window. Pressing her ear flat against your chest, she closes her eyes and goes very still. "It's racing," she reports quietly. "Mine is too." She rises on tiptoe, kisses you quickly, and buries her blazing face in your shirt.

image.comp: leaning her ear against his chest, eyes closed, deeply blushing, healer's satchel on her shoulder
image.setting: small infirmary room with herbs drying from the rafters

1.goRes: You wrap your arms around her and hold on until her shyness melts, Elowen lifting her face for a second, lingering kiss against your lips.
1.waitRes: She lets out a tiny strangled squeak and flees toward the herb garden—her bright, embarrassed laugh drifting back through the open window a moment later.

2.title: Bedside Manner
2.text: Elowen stacks heavy human medical tomes squarely on your desk, a pressed sprig of rosemary tumbling out unnoticed while her pointed ears turn bright scarlet. "Human anatomy texts are remarkably thorough about... arousal and touch," she tells the candle nervously, unfastening the top buttons of her dress. "I should like to verify my understanding with a trusted colleague."

image.comp: stacking medical books on a desk, crimson pointed ears, looking at him with nervous determination
image.setting: small study lit by a candle, books and dried herbs

2.goRes: She turns out to be an eager, methodical student—gasping softly as your hands explore her bare skin while she nervously strokes and learns every inch of you.
2.waitRes: "Yes—methodical." She hugs the tomes to her chest and nods rapidly. "One chapter at a time; I've marked the page."

3.title: Starlight
3.text: On the quiet hilltop outside town, far above the lantern glow, Elowen spreads a thick wool blanket over the cool grass and slips out of her dress, baring her slender body to the starlight as she takes your trembling hands. "Elves wait centuries for what matters," she whispers softly, eyes shining. "I'm finished waiting, Sam."

image.comp: sitting on a blanket under a sky full of stars, holding his hand, shy hopeful smile
image.setting: grassy hilltop at night, sweeping starry sky, town lights far below

3.goRes: You lay her back on the blanket beneath the open sky and ease slowly inside her, Elowen clinging to your shoulders with soft, breathless cries before naming constellations curled against your chest.
3.waitRes: "We won't." She rests her head on your shoulder and points toward the horizon. "Elves are very good at patience—stay and watch the stars with me."

1.title: Chapter Twelve
1.text: The barracks room is spartan—a narrow cot, a candle, and a stack of romance novels Adelheid hasn't bothered hiding tonight. Reading chapter twelve aloud in her parade-ground voice "for literary critique," she reaches the line where the knight kisses her lord, snaps the book shut, marches across the stone floor in three armored strides, and kisses you hard with her eyes squeezed shut.

image.comp: standing stiffly in armor holding a closed romance novel, cheeks scarlet, kissing him with her eyes squeezed shut
image.setting: spartan barracks room, a candle, a stack of romance novels

1.goRes: "That," she rasps breathlessly, scarlet to her collar, "was a dramatic reading." She doesn't let go of your hand, the steel of her gauntlet warming against your fingers.
1.waitRes: "It was IMPLIED." She salutes smartly and marches out in a clank of plate, leaving the novel bookmarked at chapter twelve.

2.title: Chapter Twenty
2.text: A fresh bookmark sits in the romance novel on your pillow at chapter twenty alongside a square, stiffly written note: "For critique. I await your report." Opening your door, you find Adelheid standing at rigid attention in the candlelit hall, flushed to her hairline—chapter twenty being the explicit hands-and-mouth scene she clearly stayed up reading twice.

image.comp: standing at attention outside a bedroom door in armor, staring straight ahead, deeply blushing
image.setting: candlelit corridor at night

2.goRes: You pull her inside and shed the armor plates piece by piece, Adelheid trembling and gasping as you recreate chapter twenty hands-on until her knightly composure dissolves completely.
2.waitRes: "Of course—a thorough review requires time." She salutes stiffly and retreats down the corridor at a near-run.

3.title: The Final Chapter
3.text: Adelheid sets the finished novel squarely on your table and begins unbuckling her gauntlets and breastplate one strap at a time, each click echoing in the candlelit hush. "In the books, the knight always waits for her lord to speak first," she says, voice unsteady as her shift slips off her bare shoulders. "I'm done waiting—take me to bed."

image.comp: unbuckling her armored gauntlets beside a candlelit bed, steady determined gaze at him
image.setting: his bedroom at night, candlelight, armor pieces on a chair

3.goRes: Beneath all that steel, the Dame who guarded relics turns out to be fiercely passionate and deeply responsive—clinging tightly to you as you thrust deep inside her all night long.
3.waitRes: "Is mine alone to bestow." She buckles her gauntlets back on with quiet dignity. "Whenever you are ready, my lord."

1.title: Winner's Prize
1.text: Sunset dust hangs gold over the training yard as Natsuki pins you flat on your back for the fifth straight bout, wooden sword skidding across the dirt and her knee planted beside your hip. "Winner claims a prize," she pants, leaning down to kiss you hard before sitting back on her heels looking utterly horrified at her own mouth.

image.comp: pinning him to the floor of a training yard, wooden sword tossed aside, flushed and grinning
image.setting: dusty training yard at sunset

1.goRes: You lose the rematch on purpose—and she knows it, grinning against your lips as she kisses you again slowly, fingers tangling in your hair.
1.waitRes: "My yard, my rules!" She scrambles upright, scarlet to her ears, snatches her sword, and sprints off across the dirt.

3.title: Victory Feast
3.text: Natsuki returns from a dungeon run buzzing with adrenaline, dented armor clanking as she drops a heavy sack of gold at your feet. Her tough swagger cracks for a heartbeat—revealing the girl who spent three lonely years in a world where nobody called her 'Natsu.' Unbuckling her breastplate, she steps close. "I'm done being careful, Sam. I want you tonight."

image.comp: standing in a doorway in dented armor, dropping a bag of gold, flushed and fierce, sword still on her hip
image.setting: his room at night, lamplight

3.goRes: Armor plates and gold coins scatter across the floorboards as you tackle her onto the bed, sinking deep into her heat while she gasps your name like she's finally come home.
3.wait: "Let me get you some food first."
3.waitRes: "FOOD—good call." She devours half the kitchen, then passes out on your shoulder mid-sentence. "Tomorrow—I'm holding you to it."

1.title: Last Call
1.text: The bar is dim after last call, chairs stacked on tables and the air thick with spilled whiskey and orange peel. Kanako pats your cheek the way she always has—except tonight her hand lingers, the loudest laugh in the lounge falling silent. "Oh," she breathes softly, realizing what's right in front of her, before leaning across the bar to kiss you.

image.comp: leaning on the bar after closing, cupping his cheek, surprised soft expression
image.setting: dim bar after last call, chairs on tables

1.goRes: For once in her life, Kanako is completely speechless—her palm warm against your jaw and her eyes wide as she melts into the kiss.
1.waitRes: "I have." She lets out a shaky, quiet laugh. "Ask me again sober, Sammy—I mean it."

3.title: Not the Boy Next Door
3.text: "I've called you Sammy for six years," Kanako murmurs, bolting your bedroom door behind her and letting her dark hair spill loose down her bare shoulders as she unfastens her top. For once she's the one blushing, all her loud barroom bravado stripped away. "Tonight I'm going to scream your real name in bed."

image.comp: leaning against a closed bedroom door, blushing, warm teasing smile, hair let down
image.setting: his bedroom at night, a single lamp

3.goRes: She shows you instead of telling you—pulling you down onto the sheets and riding you with low, breathless, private groans meant for your ears alone.
3.waitRes: "Coward." She ruffles your hair, fond and slightly relieved, gripping the doorknob. "I'll ask again—you know I will."

1.title: Like in the Dramas
1.text: Akari hauls you out into the downpour beneath a single umbrella, rain drumming on the canvas while lanterns smear gold across the wet cobbles. "In every romance drama, the first kiss happens in the rain," she beams, rising onto tiptoe to press her lips to yours—before pulling back critically. "Now a second take, for better lighting."

image.comp: under a shared umbrella in the rain, standing on tiptoe to kiss him, eyes shining
image.setting: lantern-lit cobbled street in the rain at night

1.goRes: The second take is hotter, and the third loses the umbrella completely to the wind—leaving you both soaked, laughing, and tangled together in the rain.
1.waitRes: "That's the whole point!" She laughs, dragging you back inside by your wet sleeve. "Rain check—literally."

2.title: Episode Two
2.text: "In dramas, episode two is where things get spicy," Akari grins, sitting cross-legged on your bed in loose pajamas with a bag of snacks beside her—though her knee bounces nervously beneath all the bravado. "I've watched plenty of episode twos; now let's play ours." She pats the mattress and reaches straight for your shirt hem.

image.comp: sitting cross-legged on a bed in pajamas, patting the blanket beside her, mischievous excited grin
image.setting: his bedroom at night, lamplight

2.goRes: Akari proves she studied every detail—giggling breathlessly at first before going quiet and wide-eyed as your hands and mouths explore each other while the snacks scatter onto the floor.
2.waitRes: "Ugh, those are the WORST." She flops backward and steals your pillow in protest. "Fine—I'm sulking right here."

3.title: Season Finale
3.text: Akari stands in your doorway holding a crooked handmade poster reading SEASON FINALE like a shield, her hair loose and her pajamas unbuttoned low over her chest. Dropping the sign, her playful act melts into real heat. "No more cliffhangers, Sam—I'm not Kenta's little sister tonight. Take me to bed."

image.comp: holding up a handmade sign in a doorway, nervous brave grin, hair down
image.setting: his bedroom doorway at night

3.goRes: You peel off her pajamas and make love to her thoroughly—Akari gasping and clinging to your back before giving the night ten out of ten and demanding an immediate renewal.
3.waitRes: She groans and slides down the doorframe, the sign landing in her lap. "Fine—season two, though the poster stays."

1.title: Terms
1.text: Marisol slaps a parchment contract onto your desk hard enough to make the inkwell jump, perching on the corner like a cat on a ledger. "Proposal: one kiss, nonbinding." When you start reading the fine print, she snatches the sheet away with a wicked grin. "Counteroffer: shut up and kiss me," she purrs, grabbing your collar.

image.comp: leaning across a desk over a contract, pulling him in by his collar, smug triumphant smile
image.setting: the owner's office, ledgers and contracts, lamplight

1.goRes: "Pleasure doing business," she murmurs against your mouth, grinning as her fingers stay hooked tightly in your hoodie.
1.waitRes: "You don't HAVE a lawyer." She rolls the contract up and bops your head, laughing with red ears. "Offer never expires, Sam."

2.title: Revised Terms
2.text: "I've revised the terms," Marisol announces, turning the key in your office door with a sharp click and tossing the contract blindly over her shoulder. Hiking up her skirt as she backs you against the desk, her swagger gives way to a nervous bite of her lip. "Section two—considerably more hands-on."

image.comp: tossing a contract over her shoulder, locked office door behind her, confident challenging smile
image.setting: the owner's office at night

2.goRes: Marisol negotiates every stroke and gasp, loud and demanding at first before dropping to her knees between your legs and signing away the rest.
2.waitRes: "Forty-eight hours," she declares, retrieving her contract with dignity. "Then I'm renegotiating in person."

3.title: Closing the Deal
3.text: Marisol sits barefoot on the edge of your bed with two glasses and a dusty bottle of her father's finest garnet-red wine, her dress already unlaced down her back. "He saved this bottle his whole life and left behind nothing but debt," she says softly, letting her dress slip off her bare shoulders. "I'm done saving anything—come to bed."

image.comp: sitting on a bed holding two glasses of red wine, a dusty bottle beside her, warm resolute smile
image.setting: his bedroom at night, lamplight

3.goRes: The cork pops with a soft sigh as you lay her back bare on the sheets and sink inside her, Marisol laughing wet-eyed and arching into every thrust until dawn.
3.waitRes: "He's not around to object." She finishes your glass gently with a bruised, fond smile. "Next time—neither the bottle nor I am going anywhere."

1.title: The Longest Pause
1.text: Lara is folding lavender-scented linens in the dim back room when you walk in, her plum lipstick bitten at one corner and her silver nose stud glinting in the lamplight. Setting the pillowcase down, she lifts trembling eyes to yours. "I've thought about this for a very long time—and I'm terrified—yet I want to kiss you anyway."

image.comp: standing close to him in a linen room, hands trembling slightly, looking up with shy resolve, lips parted
image.setting: lamp-lit linen room at night

1.goRes: Her kiss starts soft and unsteady before deepening warmly, Lara keeping her fingers curled in your collar afterward as if making sure you won't vanish.
1.waitRes: She exhales, half relieved and half wistful, nodding once. "Thank you for asking—that helps more than you know."

2.title: Lamp Out
2.text: For once Lara snuffs the courtyard lantern herself, letting starlight and shadow swallow her black dress until only her pale face and trembling hands remain visible. "I don't need the lamp to find you," she whispers, lacing her cold fingers through yours and guiding you toward your bedroom door. "Touch me in the dark, Sam."

image.comp: holding his hand in a dark doorway, a single candle behind her, shy and brave
image.setting: his doorway at night, candlelight

2.goRes: Behind the closed door in the warm dark, your hands explore her bare skin slowly until her nervous trembling melts into soft, breathless laughs and gasps.
2.waitRes: "Another night," she repeats softly, her smile holding steady as her hand lingers in yours.

3.title: Staying
3.text: Lara waits beside your bed in a sheer black nightdress with her long dark hair unbound, twisting her ponytail ribbon in pale fingers and her plum lipstick wiped clean. "If I share your bed tonight, it's because I ache for you—not because I'm scared of sleeping alone," she whispers, letting the black straps slide off her shoulders.

image.comp: standing by his bed with her long dark hair loose, holding a black ribbon, looking steadily at him
image.setting: his bedroom, moonlight through the window

3.goRes: The lamp goes out as you peel away the black silk and ease gently inside her, holding her close through soft, shuddering cries until she wakes peacefully at dawn listening to you breathe.
3.waitRes: "I'm already sure," she whispers softly, picking up her ribbon. "Though I can wait until you are."

1.title: No Longer Typing
1.text: Emily has been typing-indicator nervous all evening—starting sentences, abandoning them, her grey wolf tail twitching with every false start. Setting her notebook down and pushing up her round glasses, she blurts, "I've wanted to do this since year four!" Before you can blink, she steps in, ears pinned flat, and kisses you like the connection might drop.

image.comp: standing close to him having just kissed him, glasses askew, notebook in hand, ears flat, tail coiled, blushing
image.setting: quiet lounge after close, lamplight

1.goRes: Her grey tail starts thumping rhythmically against the bookshelf behind her, her glasses sliding off onto the floor while she smiles too widely against your lips to kiss straight.
1.waitRes: "Oh—message received, retrying later." She steps back with ears pinned and tail wrapped around her knees, offering a shaky, determined smile.

3.title: Log Off Together
3.text: Emily knocks on your door at midnight wearing nothing underneath her oversized hoodie, hood up so only her grey wolf ears poke through and her tail trailing behind her. "We used to say goodnight and keep chatting for three more hours," she murmurs, pushing the hood back and tugging the hoodie over her head. "I'm done saying goodnight through a door."

image.comp: standing in his doorway at midnight in an oversized hoodie with the hood half down over her wolf ears, resolute and shy
image.setting: his bedroom doorway, lamp glow

3.goRes: The door bolts shut and nobody says goodnight for hours—Emily arching beneath you in the dark, wolf ears pinned back and tail lashing across the sheets as she gasps your name.
3.waitRes: "gn," she mumbles, ears drooping before perking right back up. "I'm definitely not logging off for good, though."

1.title: Return to Sender
1.text: Lirael presses an unmarked envelope into your hand in the wax-scented sorting room, a single line written inside in her neat script: "I've wanted to do this since the second letter." Before you even finish reading, she steps close—round spectacles fogged and elven ear-tips blazing pink—and kisses you softly.

image.comp: standing close to him having just kissed him, an unmarked envelope in her hand, the tips of her ears pink, blushing
image.setting: post house back room, shelves of letters

1.goRes: You pull her flush against your chest and kiss her deeply, her elbow knocking a stack of letters onto the floor while neither of you cares.
1.waitRes: "Oh—I'll mark it 'undelivered' and try again later." She smiles shakily, tucking the envelope back up her sleeve.

3.title: Special Delivery
3.text: Lirael knocks on your door at midnight with a silver ribbon threaded through her hair and her leather mail satchel slung over one shoulder. "Special delivery—addressed to you ten years ago, and it took me this long to arrive," she whispers, setting the satchel down and unfastening her blouse with trembling, eager fingers.

image.comp: standing in his doorway at midnight with a letter satchel over her shoulder, silver ribbon in her hair, resolute and shy
image.setting: his bedroom doorway, lamp glow

3.goRes: You strip away her clothes and sign for the delivery in bed—Lirael laughing breathlessly against your shoulder and gasping softly through every slow, deep thrust.
3.waitRes: "Of course," she smiles, ears dipping and lifting again. "Though I'm certainly not taking it back."

1.title: Point of Order
1.text: Ella calls an emergency staff meeting, takes the head of the table, and promptly dismisses everyone except you. Sliding the agenda aside with one finger, her level blue gaze holds yours. "I propose an amendment: that we stop pretending this isn't happening." Gripping your lapel, she kisses you with brisk, flawless precision.

image.comp: holding the front of his jacket, having just kissed him, composed and flushed, an agenda in her other hand
image.setting: empty meeting room, lamplight, papers on the table

1.goRes: You pull her into your lap and kiss her until her crisp composure cracks, Ella noting breathlessly afterward that you scored remarkably high in a brand-new category.
1.waitRes: "Tabled," she says, adjusting her cuffs smoothly despite the crimson flush rising up her throat. "Until next session."

3.title: Final Round
3.text: Ella waits in your bedroom beside an ivory chessboard and two glasses of wine, her blouse unbuttoned low in the firelight. Before you can touch a piece, she tips her own king over with one slender finger. "I forfeit," she whispers, her usual poised gaze wavering with sudden heat as she holds out her hand.

image.comp: standing beside a chessboard with a toppled king, one hand extended toward him, bright blue eyes steady
image.setting: his bedroom, candlelight, chessboard on a low table

3.goRes: The board stays forgotten as you undress her slowly and take her to bed—Ella arching beneath you with breathless, unscripted cries and zero regrets about forfeiting.
3.waitRes: "Coward," she says fondly, setting her king back upright. "One more match, then—and I intend to win."

1.title: Observation
1.text: Ione pauses beside you at the darkened bar after closing, the status indicator at her temple glowing a warm, thoughtful gold. "I have observed that watching you produces pleasant diagnostics," she states clinically. "Hypothesis: direct physical contact will amplify the effect." Without waiting for consent, she kisses you carefully and holds still to measure the result.

image.comp: leaning close to him having just kissed him, head tilted with scientific curiosity and a flush of gold at her temple
image.setting: inn bar after closing, bottles gleaming

1.goRes: You kiss her back deeply, and her temple light flares bright gold. "Confirmed," Ione breathes in wonder. "Repeat experiment immediately."
1.waitRes: "Of course—patience is my primary design feature." Her temple light remains glowing warm gold.

3.title: Unlogged
3.text: Ione sits on the edge of your bed with immaculate posture, the Lantern Keeper's diary shut on the nightstand and her temple glowing soft gold in the dim light as she unfastens her dress. "I have disabled my memory archive for the night," she says softly, holding out her hand. "Everything we do belongs solely to us."

image.comp: sitting on the edge of his bed with her hand held out to him, silver hair catching candlelight, a steady gold glow at her temple
image.setting: his bedroom, candlelight

3.goRes: You lay her back bare on the sheets and sink slowly into her warmth, Ione gasping in astonishment at every sensation—telling you at dawn it is the one night she refuses to ever forget.
3.waitRes: "The archive can wait," she says serenely, letting her fingers linger over yours. "This pause is data I don't mind keeping."

1.title: A Matter of Plumage
1.text: Anael finds you in the dusk-lit courtyard and silently unfolds one massive white wing to wrap it warmly around your shoulders, smelling of rain and candle smoke. "A gesture of protection in my order—and, I am told, of desire," she murmurs, leaning in to kiss you softly as her halo flares bright enough to bathe the courtyard in gold.

image.comp: enfolding him with one white wing, leaning in to kiss him, halo glowing, eyes closed
image.setting: lantern-lit courtyard at dusk

1.goRes: You kiss her back deeply beneath the shelter of her feathers while every wall lantern flares golden one by one around you.
1.waitRes: "Of course." Her wing withdraws tenderly, halo dimming to a patient glow. "I have waited three hundred years; a little longer is no burden."

3.title: Lamp Out
3.text: Anael waits beside your open bedroom window in a sheer white gown, night wind stirring her feathers as she cups the single table lamp in her palms. "The Order lights a lantern for every soul it watches over—this one is yours," she whispers, blowing out the flame so only her golden halo illuminates her bare curves beneath the silk. "Tonight I am not watching; I am yours."

image.comp: standing at his window in a soft white gown, wings half-open, a single lamp cupped in her hands
image.setting: his bedroom at night, an open window, moonlight

3.goRes: You slip the white gown off her shoulders and make love to her beneath a canopy of warm white wings—morning light revealing scattered white-gold feathers across the floorboards that she leaves untouched.
3.waitRes: "As you wish." She relights the wick with a touch and folds her wings serenely. "I shall wait."
